title: Soluble ACE2 Is Not a Treatment Verdict
source_visual_limits: The exact 2022 observational hypertensive COVID-19 paper, with its published circulating ACE2/angiotensin-II figures. No third-party 2021 review graphics, patient photos, or causal claims.
human_review: NOT APPROVED — listen, watch, verify panel identities and licensing before live embed
narrator: Kokoro ONNX, synthetic, not a real researcher narration

headline: TWO BLOOD
MARKERS
chapters.narration: This clinical study measured circulating ACE two and angiotensin two in two hundred hypertensive patients with COVID nineteen. It is an observational analysis, not a treatment trial.

headline: SEVERITY
AND ACE TWO
chapters.narration: The original dot plots compare circulating ACE two and angiotensin two across mild, moderate, and severe illness, with the authors' reported confidence intervals.

headline: HIGHER IN
SEVERE CASES
chapters.narration: The reported soluble ACE two level was about one point nine times higher in severe disease than in mild cases. This does not establish the direction of causation.

headline: FOUR MEDICINE
CLASSES
chapters.narration: The researchers compared patients taking ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, beta blockers, and calcium channel blockers. These were recorded exposures, not randomly assigned drugs.

headline: REAL ASSAY
DISTRIBUTIONS
chapters.narration: The original figure shows variation between medication groups in circulating ACE two and angiotensin two. These are blood assays, not direct measurements of membrane receptor expression.

headline: GROUPS AND
ILLNESS SEVERITY
chapters.narration: The third figure separates medication classes by disease severity. It reports treatment group associations within an already ill population, not clinical benefit from starting a drug.

headline: ASSOCIATION
IS NOT CAUSE
chapters.narration: Medication choice, baseline cardiovascular disease, age, and illness severity can all shape the observed associations. The study cannot resolve all of those differences.

headline: MEASURED
NOT PRESCRIBED
chapters.narration: The contribution is a clinical biochemical observation linking treatment context, soluble ACE two, and angiotensin two. It does not tell a patient to change medication.
